svg.title: D14 minus D0 changes in slip count, total slip-event score, and percentage of time stopped
svg.desc: Circles: mice; diamonds: cage means; bars: mouse means. Three crossings per mouse. No group pair significant after within-metric Holm adjustment. Time stopped in percentage points. Original panel scales retained.
